goal: Provide a public utility that determines whether a supplied string has a practical, commonly accepted email-address format.

alternatives.title: Local pragmatic validator
tradeoffs: Requires maintaining a small set of validation rules and representative tests.
Adds no dependency and keeps behavior easy to understand and tailor.

alternatives.title: Established validation package
tradeoffs: Adds a dependency that must be evaluated, updated, and kept compatible.
Provides broader handling of email syntax and benefits from validation cases maintained by others.

self_critique.weakest_point: Practical email syntax is inherently subjective, so unusual but technically valid addresses may be rejected.
self_critique.cut_or_change: If unusual RFC-valid addresses are important, replace the pragmatic-syntax assumption with explicitly defined compatibility requirements.
